entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: histogram subquery outer function input has %s sample kind
entries.rationale: lowerOuterRangeFnOverSubquery supplies kind from an already lowered inner plan and reaches this helper only on rowsMayContainHistograms' conservative path. Valid PromQL lowerers publish float, histogram, or mixed schemas; for this path float was excluded, leaving histogram or mixed. Any other kind denotes a malformed internal schema, which is kept off the float path and rejected here.
